fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Compare/CompareTrucks.cy.js#Compare - CompareTrucks [hi] — Compare Trucks TC-CT-06: Popular Models by Category tab switch on Compare Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CT-06
**Title:** Popular Models by Category tab switch on Compare Trucks
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Switch Popular Models by Category to Mini Trucks on Compare Trucks.

**Expected Result:**
Mini Trucks becomes the active tab.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Compare Trucks page
2. Scroll to Popular Models by Category
3. Click Mini Trucks
4. Verify Mini Trucks is active
